subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: When an awaited external completion occurs, the wake channel shall re-enter the drive at its front door with a normalized wake signal, and the drive shall resume through the resume protocol — journal replay plus goal-object verification — within the configured latency bound.
rationale: the clock moves from the operator to the factory (AP-2)
fit_criterion: live drill: a merged awaited proposal resumes the drive unattended within the bound; the resumed session verifies at goal objects before any act
